topic: Fixing daily aggregation bug in analytics
summary_markdown:
A data issue was identified where the hourly aggregate model prediction fails to populate the daily aggregate when a specific hour has a prediction but no recorded sessions. This bug affects all data starting from October 18th, particularly for clusters that were reaggregated using templates after October 3rd.

[me] plans to rebuild and fix the daily aggregate without performing a full reaggregation, which could potentially introduce other issues. The initial test will be run on the `alex_test_1` dataset.
decisions: The bug affects daily aggregation for data starting from 18.10.
action_items: [me] will rebuild and fix the daily aggregate using `alex_test_1` for testing.
